scenes.script: Your retirement account just lived through whiplash. Here's what ninety days did to your money — by the numbers.
scenes.headline:
WHAT Q2 DID
TO YOUR
MONEY.
scenes.sub: 3 numbers you won't get anywhere else

scenes.script: First, our gauge. The Ledger Whiplash Index — how hard the market swung between quarters — just hit nineteen point two. The sharpest reversal since twenty-twenty.
scenes.label: METRIC 01 · WHIPLASH INDEX
scenes.headline:
HOW HARD
IT SWUNG.

scenes.script: Second: the Breadth Score. In Q1's crash, two hundred and ninety of the five hundred stocks still beat the index. Score: fifty-eight out of a hundred. Translation — the pain was five big names. Not the market.
scenes.label: METRIC 02 · BREADTH SCORE
scenes.headline:
58/100:
A NARROW
CRASH.

scenes.script: Because Q2 flipped everything: up fourteen point nine percent — the best quarter since twenty-twenty. Records at the Dow.
scenes.label: Q2 · THE FLIP
scenes.headline:
BEST QUARTER
SINCE 2020.

big.caption: S&P 500 · Q2 2026 — Dow at a record

scenes.script: Now, the part nobody else shows you: your money. A one hundred thousand dollar index fund in January, fell to ninety-five seven by March. By June thirtieth? About one hundred and ten thousand. The dip cost you nothing — unless you sold it.
scenes.label: METRIC 03 · $100K TRACKER
scenes.headline:
YOUR $100K,
TRACKED.

scenes.script: But keep two warning lights on. Inflation: two point four in January. Four point two by May. And hiring just halved — fifty-seven thousand jobs, versus one seventy-two in May.
scenes.label: TWO WARNING LIGHTS
scenes.headline:
CRACKS
UNDERNEATH.

scenes.script: And Bitcoin never joined the party: thirteen days of ETF outflows, a twenty-one month low, two red quarters straight.
scenes.label: THE ODD ONE OUT
scenes.headline:
BITCOIN
SAT OUT.

scenes.script: So: records up top. Cracks underneath. That's the real Q2 scoreboard.
scenes.headline:
RECORDS UP TOP.
CRACKS
UNDERNEATH.

scenes.script: Next quarter, we re-run every number: the Whiplash Index. The Breadth Score. And your hundred-K tracker. Same time, next quarter.
scenes.headline:
SAME NUMBERS.
NEXT
QUARTER.
